accuracyClaim: source-bound frozen shells and explicitly estimated limited site details

kings.method: Small source-registered hall-front apron. Photo-visible masonry plinth/stone balustrades and human-scale context guide a simplified local drop; no calibrated photogrammetry. Width uses .96 of the OSM roof width only as a modelling constraint; front length deliberately limited to avoid invented whole courtyards. Steps are generated from drop/max-riser, not counted in a survey.

uncertainty.boundsMeaning: broad modelling allowances, not guaranteed/statistical confidence

kings.joiningStatus: pending surveyed floors/current terrain cut and external path validation

ridgeEnds.method: Representative pale ceramic upward curl silhouettes supplement old ridge caps; source roof detail hall attribution unknown. Not dragon/chifinial carving reproduction.
